newsitem.title: USA: Premier in pact with Baxter, Allegiance worth $1 billion a year.
newsitem.headline: Premier in pact with Baxter, Allegiance worth $1 billion a year.

text.p: Premier Inc., an alliance of hospital and health systems, said Monday it entered into a seven-year deal to buy medical supplies from Baxter International Inc. and Allegiance Healthcare Corp. with a potential value of $1 billion per year.
Premier said the pact includes group purchasing agreements for intravenous solutions, drug delivery systems, and surgical and respiratory therapy products, among other things.
The company said the agreements represent the largest group purchasing award for healthcare supplies in history.
Premier resulted from the merger earlier this year of American Healthcare Systems Inc., SunHealth Alliance and Premier Health Alliance Inc.
Premier serves 700 hospitals and healthcare facilities and about 1,100 other affiliated hospital and healthcare organisations.
Allegiance Healthcare is the U.S. subsidiary of Allegiance Corp. It became an independent, public company in October after it was spun off from Baxter International.
